content.title: This Animal Health Stock Tanks on Earnings. Pig and Chicken Medication Revenue Slumps.

The company posted adjusted earnings of $1.70 a share for the third quarter, above analysts’ consensus estimates of $1.62.  Zoetis  saw a particularly steep decline in revenue for its swine and poultry medicines.
